dataset.license: MIT (as stated on the Hugging Face dataset card)
dataset.citation: Pengpun et al., ACL SRW 2024, https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-srw.38

selection.note: Weakly supervised rewriting pairs; the dataset labels these examples as summarization, not paraphrase or style transfer.
selection.thai_script_policy: source_text, target_text, and instruction contain no Unicode letters or marks outside Thai block U+0E00-U+0E7F; numbers and punctuation are allowed

split.method: deterministic shuffle, 80/10/10 split, then Thai-script filter

known_limitations: Targets may summarize, omit details, or introduce unsupported facts; length filtering does not guarantee semantic equivalence.
The source dataset has no labels for formal, casual, or other Thai style levels.
The source dataset is synthetic and may contain factual errors or model-generated biases.
